title: Snowsports School Tuition Reckoned on the Block Price of the Product Booked
content:
The tuition raised for a Snowsports School booking is the product's block price, and the figure is rounded to the nearest cent. Where the booking earns no reduction the block price stands as it is, and nothing is added to it.

Tuition is raised once for the booking, whatever the block holds, and an add-on the household asks for alongside the lesson is never folded into it.

## The amounts that enter the reckoning

No reduction in percentage points is earned on the booking, so the reduction that acts on the block price stands at 0 points. The charge for a named instructor stands at 0.00 USD. The place holding supplement stands at 0.00 USD. The rate window supplement stands at 0 USD.

The points reduction acts on the block price and on nothing else; the charge for a named instructor, the place holding supplement and the rate window supplement are then added to the figure the reduction leaves; and the tuition raised is that total rounded once to the nearest cent.

## A figure worked through on a hypothetical booking

Take a booking of the Six-Week Development Programme, whose block price is 749.00 USD and whose block holds six sessions.

The reduction of 0 points leaves the block price at 749.00 USD. The charge for a named instructor adds 0.00 USD, the place holding supplement adds 0.00 USD and the rate window supplement adds 0 USD. The tuition raised on that booking is therefore 749.00 USD, raised once for the whole booking rather than six times over, and a lift ticket or rental the household asks for alongside the lessons is raised apart from it rather than folded into it.

## Points of judgement

- The tuition is reckoned on the block price of the product booked, not on its session price, and not on the number of sessions the block holds.
- A block of six sessions and a block of a single session are each raised in one tuition entry.
- Rounding is done once, at the end, to the nearest cent.

The block prices this reckoning reads are published product by product on the Snowsports School tariff.
